items.question: How many gurus manifested by Īśa are depended upon by men?
premises: men depend on that manifested stream
items.inference: The verse states that the Īśa-manifested siddha-stream gurus depended upon by men are eight in number.
uncertainties: the exact antecedent of tāḥ is not fully explicit
vasu is read here as the numeral eight
items.plain_english: Men would depend on that; therefore those are eight in number.
